name: Mail2Rust Studio Desktop
description: Universal offline email and mailbox migration suite in pure Rust with zero-Outlook PST generation, forensic eDiscovery, dual Win32/Iced desktop GUIs, and stdio MCP server.
majorCapabilities: 64-bit Unicode [MS-PST] binary container reader, writer & validator (zero Outlook COM)
15+ mailbox formats, IMAP/TLS, IMAP-to-IMAP sync & JMAP RFC 8620/8621
Outlook & Office diagnostics (AutoComplete .NK2, attachments, comms stats, contacts, add-ins)
Forensic Bates stamping, SHA-256 Merkle roots & eDiscovery regex search
15-tool MCP JSON-RPC stdio server with read-only/mutating policy gates

tools.summary: Inspect magic bytes and identify mailbox format (PST, OST, MBOX, EML, EMLX, MSG, OLM, Maildir).
Validate 64-bit Unicode MS-PST binary integrity, CRC-32 header, and B-Trees without Outlook.
Convert mailbox between formats (e.g. MBOX to PST, PST to EML tree, EML to PST, Maildir to PST).
Perform forensic audit on mailbox: compute SHA-256 hashes, Bates stamping, and chain of custody.
Split oversized mailbox (e.g. >20GB or >50GB) into chunked volume archives preserving folder hierarchies.
Merge multiple disparate mailbox archives into a unified container with cross-archive deduplication.
Edit an Outlook .NK2 / Stream_Autocomplete_*.dat file (add/remove/update weight/dedup/merge) with atomic save.
Parse and inspect an Outlook .NK2 or Stream_Autocomplete_*.dat file (read-only).
List Microsoft Office & Outlook add-ins from live Windows Registry or offline NTUSER.DAT/SOFTWARE regf hives (read-only).
Enable or disable an Office/Outlook add-in LoadBehavior in live Windows Registry (mutating; requires AllowMutating + confirm_destructive=true).
List attachments in a PST, OST, MSG, MBOX, or EML source (read-only).
Bulk extract filtered attachments from PST/OST/MSG/MBOX/EML into a destination directory with SHA-256 custody manifest (writes files to disk; requires AllowMutating + confirm_destructive=true).
Strip matching attachments from a PST/OST/MSG container (mutating; requires AllowMutating + confirm_destructive=true).
Read and decode Outlook contacts and distribution lists from PST/OST, OAB, NK2, or vCard (read-only).
Aggregate PST/OST/MSG/MBOX/EML communication statistics by correspondent, domain, folder, or month (read-only).
